content.short: Meson is a leading cross-chain bridge optimized for fast and cost-efficient stablecoin and wrapped token transfers between blockchains including Mantle.
content.description: Meson is a specialized cross-chain bridge using hash time locked contracts (HTLC) and a network of liquidity providers to achieve fast finality and low fees for stablecoin transfers. Optimized specifically for USDC, USDT, and other stable assets across dozens of chains, Meson provides some of the best rates for stable cross-chain transfers available. Its integration with Mantle makes it the preferred solution for stable asset movements in and out of the network.
content.meta: Meson is a fast, cost-efficient cross-chain bridge for stablecoin transfers to and from Mantle. Discover Meson on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
